content: The Munshaʾāt-i Turka confirms warm relations between Ibn Turka and Niʿmat Allāh and Qāsim-i Anvār; it preserves a letter from Ibn Turka to Shāhrukh, answering a summons to attend his court, to be communicated to the newly ascendant ruler by Niʿmat Allāh (§2.1.3.1.1, no. 16). The pages read do not date it.
